WHO Warns of 39 Million Deaths from Antimicrobial Resistance

The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued a warning regarding the threat of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), stating it could lead to 39 million deaths over the next 25 years. The organization is sounding the alarm on this growing global health crisis.
